# pr-lint.yml

<link-summary>Inputs, secrets and outputs of the reusable workflow Pull request checks.</link-summary>

```text
Checks a pull request before anything else runs:

  title          a Conventional Commits title (feat(scope): subject), the scopes being the
                 package names of the repository and extra-scopes
  branch-policy  only allowed branches merge into the release branch (develop, release-please
                 branches and hotfixes by default)

The caller triggers on pull_request with types opened, edited, synchronize and reopened, so
editing the title runs the check again, and grants pull-requests: read.
```

```yaml
jobs:
  pr-lint:
    uses: davils-com/workflows/.github/workflows/pr-lint.yml@v1
```

## Inputs

| Input | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `working-directory` | string | `.` | Directory of the root pubspec.yaml, relative to the repository root. |
| `discovery` | string | empty | Packages discovered before; empty discovers them here. |
| `title-enabled` | boolean | `true` | Check the title. |
| `types` | string | empty | Allowed types, newline separated; empty allows the Conventional Commits types. |
| `scopes` | string | `auto` | auto (the package names plus extra-scopes), none (any scope) or a newline separated list. |
| `extra-scopes` | string | `deps\nci\ndocs\nrelease\nworkspace` | Scopes allowed besides the package names, newline separated. |
| `require-scope` | boolean | `false` | Require a scope. |
| `subject-pattern` | string | empty | Regular expression the subject has to match, such as ^(?![A-Z]).+$. |
| `branch-policy-enabled` | boolean | `true` | Check the source branch of pull requests into the release branch. |
| `release-branch` | string | `main` | The release branch. |
| `allowed-sources` | string | `["develop","release-please--*","hotfix/*"]` | JSON array of branch globs allowed to merge into the release branch. |
| `runners` | string | `{}` | JSON object of runner labels. |
| `harden-runner` | boolean | `true` | Run step-security/harden-runner first. |
| `harden-runner-egress-policy` | string | `audit` | audit or block. |
| `harden-runner-allowed-endpoints` | string | empty | Endpoints allowed with the block policy, space separated. |

## Permissions the caller grants

- `contents: read`
- `pull-requests: read`
